translation: What makes someone a smart person?
What are you asking so suddenly?

I heard Kyon and Koizumi talking about it with
each other.

Smart people, huh…? I don't think you're
qualified, Mikuru.
Definitely not, if you ask me!

Yeah… I'm not clever… I'm always clumsy, and
I'm not very good at getting to the point…

Hey, don't feel bad. I wouldn't call Kyon smart
either.

Yuki is pretty clever, but that's not quite the
same as being smart.

I think Koizumi is the only one I can really call
smart, personally.

Really? I guess it's not so bad then if Nagato
and Kyon aren't smart either.

Even if you're not smart, as long as you're
good in other ways, that's all that matters.
I'll try to think of it that way too.
